i.norm: Verifies that computing the covariance matrix from an empty (zero-column) matrix throws a RuntimeException. An Array2DRowRealMatrix created with the no-arg constructor has zero rows and zero columns; AbstractRealMatrix rejects column dimensions that are not positive (the error message reads "0 is smaller than, or equal to, the minimum (0)").
Build a Covariance instance from a 13-row, 1-column data set (bias-corrected = false).
An empty matrix (no rows, no columns) is not a valid input for covariance computation.
AbstractRealMatrix enforces that column count must exceed 0.
